title: The Lantern Fair
setting: A night market in a made-up river town. Every name here is a character, never a player.

scenes.title: Dusk at the stalls
opening: The first lanterns go up along the river.
Somewhere a stall is missing its light.

beats.prompt: Tamsin climbs to the dark stall's hook.

outcomes.strong: The lantern catches first time, and the whole row brightens.
outcomes.weak: It catches, but a pane cracks in the heat.
outcomes.miss: The hook gives; the lantern rolls under the stalls.

beats.prompt: Oro keeps the crowd from noticing.

outcomes.strong: Five clubs and a borrowed hat: nobody looks anywhere else.
outcomes.weak: Most of them watch. One child watches the stall instead.
outcomes.miss: A club goes into the river, and every head turns.

proposes.fact: Old Vell left it dark on purpose, to see who would notice.

scenes.title: The lantern bridge
opening: At midnight every lantern is carried onto the bridge.

beats.prompt: Tamsin carries the last lantern across.

outcomes.strong: It is the brightest one there.
outcomes.miss: It goes out halfway, and the fair waits in the dark.

beats.prompt: Will the fair come back next year?

proposes.fact: The fair comes back next year, one stall longer.
